name: local-harness-agent
description: A local, Ollama-backed coding agent exposed as a VS Code chat participant (@localagent).

chatParticipants.name: localagent
chatParticipants.description: Ask your local Ollama model to inspect or edit files in this workspace

localAgent.model.description: Ollama model name to use. Must already be pulled with `ollama pull <name>`.

localAgent.maxTurns.description: Max tool-calling round-trips per message before the agent stops itself.

localAgent.streaming.description: Stream partial responses as they arrive. Some Ollama/model combinations drop tool_calls when streaming, causing the agent to describe edits instead of making them — disable this if the agent stops calling write_file.

localAgent.numCtx.description: Context window size (in tokens) requested from Ollama. Larger workspaces/files need a bigger value or the model will silently truncate context and may write back incomplete files.

localAgent.headroomEnabled.description: Compress conversation context and large tool outputs via a local Headroom proxy before sending them to Ollama. Requires a separately running proxy (see heardoom_server/README.md) — safely no-ops if it isn't reachable.

localAgent.headroomBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Headroom compression proxy (only used when localAgent.headroomEnabled is true).

localAgent.headroomMinCharsToCompress.description: Minimum character length a tool result must reach before it's routed through Headroom's SharedContext for compression.

localAgent.subagentsEnabled.description: Let the agent delegate self-contained subtasks to a spawn_subagent tool, which runs its own nested tool-calling loop and returns only its final answer. Off by default — enable once you trust the base agent's tool use, since a subagent's file writes still require your approval but run with less visibility into what it's doing along the way.

localAgent.subagentMaxTurns.description: Max tool-calling round-trips a single subagent gets before it's forced to give its best answer. Kept lower than localAgent.maxTurns since a subagent should be handling one focused subtask, not an open-ended one.
